findings: Reported combined cash line includes a broader intangible perimeter; exact annual PP&E-only cash amount is not established.
Patents/licensed technology and acquired technology/customer assets are distinct book classes; their balances/additions/amortization do not exhaust annual cash payments.

Unpaid acquisitions of property/equipment/intangibles, operating ROU additions, financing principal and acquisition/transaction consideration are separate; no addition or subtraction equation approved.
Separate Groq cash 13 billion and developed-technology value 2.5 billion are outside the combined 6.042 billion line; no overlap/residual adjustment.
